compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1+DD3+DD5 (harvest-worktree-specific coverage): Ensure T4's library integration is RED-tested with dedicated assertions, not just relying on the existing test-harvest-worktree.sh.

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree-guards.sh` covering:

- Given harvest-worktree.sh attempting to remove a worktree whose branch has an open PR (mocked via PATH override of gh)
- When invoked WITHOUT --force
- Then exit code non-zero, refusal message identifies 'open_pr_with_ci', PR URL printed

- Same setup but WITH --force
- Then exit code 0, refusal message + PR URL still printed (bypass mode)

- Given gh CLI unavailable (PATH set to exclude gh) AND no override
- When invoked
- Then exit code non-zero, error 'GUARD_PR_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: gh CLI not installed'

- Given protected branch (e.g., main)
- When invoked with --force
- Then exit code STILL non-zero (protected branch is NOT --force-bypassable per T4 contract)

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_harvest_worktree_guards]`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree-guards.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree-guards.sh
- [ ] Test covers refusal, --force bypass, gh-unavailable, protected-branch-not-bypassable
  Verify: grep -cE 'refus|bypass|GUARD_PR_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE|protected' tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree-guards.sh | awk '{exit (\$1>=4?0:1)}'
- [ ] Test mocks gh via PATH override
  Verify: grep -qE 'mktemp.*bin|PATH=.*bin' tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree-guards.sh
- [ ] After T4, test passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree-guards.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
